subject.title: feat: add jsonl support to memory indexer

question: Should builtin memory-core ingest arbitrary JSONL from `memorySearch.extraPaths`, or should structured raw logs remain owned by the dedicated session-memory path and external converter/plugin backends?
rationale: The missing capability is source-proven, but repository policy and the existing session implementation make record schema, privacy, visibility, and memory-backend ownership intentional product decisions rather than a mechanical extension change.

options.title: Keep arbitrary JSONL external
options.body: Document a converter/plugin or QMD workflow for arbitrary logs and retain builtin JSONL indexing only for OpenClaw session transcripts with existing visibility controls.

options.title: Define core JSONL ingestion
options.body: Approve supported record shapes and privacy rules, then implement the complete discovery, parsing, watcher, retrieval, citation, documentation, and regression-test surface.

recommendation.title: Keep arbitrary JSONL external
recommendation.body: Document a converter/plugin or QMD workflow for arbitrary logs and retain builtin JSONL indexing only for OpenClaw session transcripts with existing visibility controls.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest history across the affected host, index, session, and documentation boundaries and already participated in the issue's product-boundary discussion.
